definitions.explanation: a formal warning or reprimand given by a superior, especially in government or organizational contexts

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{訓告|くんこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I received an official reprimand from my boss.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{職員|しょくいん}→職員：20206_shokuin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{訓告|くんこく}⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: That employee was given a formal reprimand as a disciplinary action.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧⟦{経理|けいり}→経理：06439_keiri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発覚|はっかく}→発覚：07629_hakkaku⟧し、⟦{担当者|たんとうしゃ}→担当者：09676_tantousha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{訓告|くんこく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|だ}された→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: When the accounting fraud was discovered, the person in charge was issued an official reprimand.

notes:
A formal disciplinary measure in Japanese organizations, particularly in government and public service. It is one of the lighter forms of punishment, below ⟦{戒告|かいこく}→戒告：15250_kaikoku⟧ (formal warning) and ⟦{減給|げんきゅう}→減給：10205_genkyuu⟧ (pay reduction) in the disciplinary hierarchy. Often appears in news reports about government officials or civil servants.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {訓告|くんこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive a reprimand
- {訓告|くんこく}⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧: reprimand as disciplinary action
- {訓告|くんこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to issue a reprimand

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{戒告|かいこく}→戒告：15250_kaikoku⟧: formal warning — heavier than {訓告|くんこく} in the disciplinary scale
- ⟦{叱責|しっせき}→叱責：09471_shisseki⟧: scolding/rebuke — less formal, can be used in any context
- ⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧: caution/warning — much lighter and more general
- ⟦{懲戒|ちょうかい}→懲戒：09469_choukai⟧: disciplinary action — broader term covering all forms of punishment
